run.label: purchase-lists
run.note: Phase B: purchase lists on test.gokesari.com (build of 487f11b, PR #231 merged as 2853b3d; migrations to 0090). Signed purchase-lists spec (staging customer + customer2), the guest tier as regression, and order-lifecycle TC-CART-001/002. TC-LIST-021/022 first failed at 15:22-15:24 UTC because another session used the same customer account (its order DB-20261024-ITRVQT at 15:22:54 UTC emptied the cart; the 500 is D-100) and passed alone at 15:36-15:38 UTC (latest rows kept). TC-CART-001/002 blocked by the suite helper sellable() reading onlineStock, which customers no longer get (D-90).
